identity_policy: name is the sound-request name (NAME/REQD); wave is the verified WAVE index; layers is the FULL set of waves in the sound, including the primary (layers[0] == wave). confidence is identity confidence only; 0x21 fidelity is a separate field and is medium for every row. ghidra rows require reqd+tone and must pass the actual SEQD/PLAY_TONE walk; audition rows require verified_index=true and are explicitly not chain-proven.
note: The S6 slice: the S5 eight plus valus.death (the tendril-burst roar) and valus.club_swing (the club whoosh). Still deferred: player.fall (no resident com_v wave) and the ambience/bed cues.

cues.name: boss01_vo_atk1
cues.chain: NAME hash -> REQD 340 -> SEQD 0x10B1. The per-sound bytecode at 0x6ABC is a parameter envelope (a9 SET_PARAM) whose PLAY_TONE operands are complex/random (a4 02 03 ...), so no fixed tone can be walked. Audition pick: wave 3 (1.202 s vocal).
cues.note: Not chain-verified. The 0x42 pair 108/109 is a large roar alternative.

cues.name: boss01_atk_hit_ground1
cues.chain: NAME hash(boss01_atk_hit_ground1) -> REQD 303 -> SEQD timeline 0x13E4 -> bytecode 0x23BA -> a4 01 43 -> TONE[43] = (key 57, wave 26); the sequence then plays tones 44-47 -> waves 27-30
cues.note: Layered sound: layers is the full set 26-30 including the primary. wave_pool_label is the pool string at index 26, not the request name. Identity high; 0x21 fidelity medium.

cues.name: boss01_vo_dmg1
cues.chain: NAME hash -> REQD 331 -> SEQD 0x11B6. The per-sound bytecode is a parameter envelope with complex/random PLAY_TONE operands; no fixed tone can be walked. Audition pick: wave 6 (1.051 s roar).

cues.name: wnd_LifeSwd_swish_t1_01
cues.chain: NAME hash -> REQD 118 -> SEQD 0x227A -> PLAY_TONE 16/17; com_obj TONE chunk is not the flat 12-byte form, so no tone->wave proof
cues.note: Audition pick: wave 7 is a 0.464 s 0x21 whoosh; identity is the ear, not a chain.

cues.name: wnd_swd_hit_gravel_t1_01
cues.chain: NAME hash -> REQD 60 -> SEQD 0x2779; no PLAY_TONE op decoded in the first window; com_obj TONE table is not flat
cues.note: Audition pick: wave 21 is a 0.708 s 0x21 impact, first gravel-hit variant.

cues.name: bvo_dmg_m
cues.chain: NAME hash -> REQD 172 -> SEQD 0x0FD0; no PLAY_TONE op decoded; com_v TONE table is not flat
cues.note: Audition pick: wave 40 is a 0.270 s 0x21 grunt.

cues.name: b_dead_by_boss
cues.chain: NAME hash -> REQD 1573 -> SEQD 0xD710; no PLAY_TONE op decoded; com_b_h TONE table is not flat
cues.note: Audition pick: wave 657 is a 0.811 s 0x21 vocal. The dedicated bvo_die_* names in com_v are sequence names beyond the 63 resident waves.

cues.name: Boss 1
cues.chain: music.sxd1 REQD track 6 is "Boss 1"; the 76-byte WAVE record 6 is 5.1 ATRAC9 (config FE761DF0 at +0x40) with start 0x22C6860 absolute in music.sxd2 (recon §2/§4)
cues.note: Streamed music, not a resident SFX: 5.1 downmixed to stereo at conversion time (R6), looped by the runtime. Selected with --music "Boss 1".

cues.name: mavo_death
cues.chain: NAME hash(mavo_death) -> REQD 165 -> SEQD. The manual chain maps tone 97 -> wave 75 and the sequence plays tones 97-99 -> waves 75-77; the SEQD bytecode has no 0x4000 marker, so walk_play_tone returns None and the row stays audition, not tool-chain-proven. Design §6.
cues.note: Layered death roar: layers is the full set 75-77 (wave 75 is 3.673 s, layer 76 5.277 s). wave_pool_label is the pool string at index 75, not the request name. Audition: a dark collapse. Fires at the tendril burst (0.4 s).

cues.name: boss01_mvt_swing_add
cues.chain: NAME hash(boss01_mvt_swing_add) -> REQD 123 -> SEQD. The manual chain maps tone 77 -> wave 55 and the sequence plays tones 77-79 -> waves 55-57; the SEQD bytecode has no 0x4000 marker, so walk_play_tone returns None and the row stays audition, not tool-chain-proven. Design §6.
cues.note: Layered club whoosh: layers is the full set 55-57 (3.490 s / 3.667 s / 3.801 s). wave_pool_label is the pool string at index 55, not the request name. Audition: a bright whoosh. Fires on the club swing (the ClubStart telegraph keeps valus.telegraph).
